architecture:
System: Benefits-Portal-135
Primary NIST family: Personnel Security (PS); evidence focus: PS-4.
Environment: GCP. Network access uses Private Service Connect; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. Control evidence: personnel transfers trigger timely access review and adjustment based on the new role. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
